'''Gastos Niovi''' was a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], serving under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]] aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']].

==Biography==
When [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel|Drommel]] tried to fight to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of himself and his crew rather than surrender to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Niovi realized that Drommel was no longer serving the good of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. He killed Drommel and assumed the title of acting commander of the [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']]. By the authority of his position, Niovi surrendered the ''Guardian'' to the Republic, in the person of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Volahn]] of the ''[[Equity]]''.
